mobends.gui.needs_world: The Mo' Bends menu opens in a world: join one and press %s.
mobends.gui.link.title: Link your Minecraft account
mobends.gui.link.enter_code: On the Mo' Bends dashboard, choose Link through the mod, then enter the code it shows you.
mobends.gui.link.confirm_prompt: Link %s to the Mo' Bends account %s?
mobends.gui.link.confirm_warning: Only link if that's your account and you got the code from the dashboard yourself.
mobends.gui.link.linked: Linked %s to the Mo' Bends account %s. You can go back to the dashboard now.
mobends.gui.link.error.unknown_code: That code doesn't work. Codes expire after 5 minutes, and only the newest one works, so get a new one on the dashboard.
mobends.gui.link.error.unknown_code_conf: That code was replaced by a newer one or expired before linking finished. Get a new code on the dashboard and enter it.
mobends.gui.link.error.not_started: Linking didn't start properly. Please try again.
mobends.gui.link.error.invalid_request: The Mo' Bends server didn't understand the request. Please try again.
mobends.gui.link.error.join_not_verified: Mojang couldn't confirm you own this account. Please try again.
mobends.gui.link.error.session_server_er: Mojang's servers can't be reached right now. Please try again later.
mobends.gui.link.error.mojang_unavailabl: Mojang's servers can't be reached right now. Please try again later.
mobends.gui.link.error.session: Minecraft couldn't verify your session. Linking needs a game signed in to your Minecraft account; restarting the launcher may help.
mobends.gui.link.error.api: Something went wrong on the Mo' Bends server. Please try again later.
mobends.gui.link.error.connection: Couldn't reach the Mo' Bends server. Check your internet connection and try again.
mobends.config.show_arrow_trails.tooltip: If true, arrow trails will be shown
mobends.config.show_sword_trails.tooltip: If true, sword trails will be shown
mobends.gui.typeorder.title: Order: %s
mobends.gui.typeorder.hint: When several types apply, the highest one wins.
mobends.gui.extensionorder.title: Extensions: %s
mobends.gui.extensionorder.hint: Extensions higher up go on top of the ones below.
mobends.gui.options.title: Options: %s
mobends.gui.supporters.pitch: Support Mo' Bends to unlock accessories for your character, seen by everyone who plays with Mo' Bends.
mobends.gui.supporters.thanks: Thank you for supporting Mo' Bends! Your accessories are unlocked, and everyone who plays with Mo' Bends sees them.
